files.note: signed-in redirect targets /(tabs)/dialer (standalone tab group has no index screen); otherwise identical
standalone copy keeps the contacts/dialer mentions the main app removed when its dialer surfaces were dropped
standalone keeps the plain static InfoPage; the main app added react-native-reanimated scroll-reveal entrance animations (via ./ScrollReveal + useReducedMotion) that the standalone does not depend on
webRef uses structural typing ({ injectJavaScript }) so it compiles across react-native-webview versions; otherwise identical
standalone has no native /account-merge screen; 'Merge now' opens the web /user/merge page via Linking instead of router.push
redirectAfterAuth fallback targets /(tabs)/dialer (standalone tab group has no index screen); otherwise identical
notification-tap fallbacks all route to the dialer home (standalone has no notifications / API-usage / admin screens)

dev-only missing-env alert text reworded (no monorepo path); also omits the intro-style reanimated AnimatedBlob decorative background the main app adds, because the standalone deliberately does not depend on react-native-reanimated (same policy as the static InfoPage entry); everything else must match the main app
launch gate simplified: no onboarding/biometric-lock routing; signed-in users go straight to the Dialer tab

root providers trimmed to what the dialer needs (no VoiceAssistant, DeepLinkRouter, ImpersonationBanner, IdleLockWarning, KeyboardProvider, RevenueCat/SubscriptionProvider, push registration, @workspace/api-client-react wiring); mounts useContactAutoSync; Stack.Screen list only carries dialer-relevant routes (search/dialer-profile/call/contacts/info/oauth-callback) — new main-app-only screens (calendars, brand-kits, delivery-projects, marketing-strategist, etc.) are not dialer surfaces and intentionally omitted
Connected-Apps OAuth completion branch removed (standalone has no connected-apps screen); session handling must match
different tab set: Dialer / Contacts / Caller ID / Events (+ header search button + nearby-event badge) instead of the main-app tabs

standalone prompts for the contacts permission on first open (requestPermission true on the initial run) and triggers the account's Google Contacts sync on open/foreground; main app is fully silent (never prompts) and additionally invalidates contact-duplicate-count. Core mechanics (persisted-fingerprint cold-start seed, account-switch retrigger via userId dep, foreground re-sync) must stay in lockstep.

same import flow; main app adds ContactImportPayload typing, a stricter FNV hash (json.length-based fingerprint, unsigned mixing per step) and non-any filtering. Fingerprint formats differ but each app only compares its own persisted values, so this is benign; behavior changes to the import/skip logic must be mirrored.
standalone hosts the dialer as a tab; main app hosts it as a stack screen. Main copy adapts listContacts() to its opts-object signature; otherwise identical (Task #5399 port).
main app has no /contacts/new form, so its saveOrEdit falls back to the /contacts list; otherwise identical (Task #5399 port).

diverged API surfaces: main copy grew its own helpers (getContact/updateContactNotes/updateContactTags/duplicate + google-sync helpers, opts-object listContacts) while the standalone keeps the original CRUD/import surface. Manual-profile types + updateContactManualProfile now exist in both.

standaloneOnly.note: source-driven unit test for the silent contact auto-sync hook (fingerprint persistence, cold-restart skip, account-switch reset, first-open prompt vs silent resumes, Google Contacts sync trigger); run via npm run test:contact-auto-sync
resilient with-proxy evaluation helper for source-driven tests, copied from artifacts/1inme-mobile/scripts/lib/extract.mjs

contacts list screen; the main app removed its app/contacts/ screens — device import goes through lib/deviceContacts.ts
incoming-call screen; removed from the main app along with the dialer surfaces

contact detail screen; removed from the main app along with the contacts surfaces
new-contact screen; removed from the main app along with the contacts surfaces
bulk contact import screen; removed from the main app along with the contacts surfaces

universal-finder modal screen; UI derived from the dialer inline search, backed by the same /api/v1/dialer/search endpoint; shows dialer suggestions on empty query
dedicated Caller ID lookup tab (main app reaches caller-id via the dialer + dialer-profile flows)

Single saved 'my location' anchoring Events near-me filtering + nearby-event alerts, set via device GPS or the shared MapPickerModal (the dialer's existing location-picker UI) — one location concept in this app, not a separate store; the main app has no equivalent single-location concept

Events directory tab anchored to lib/eventsLocation.ts (near-me toggle backed by MapPickerModal, tag chips, search); main app's app/events/index.tsx is a plain paginated directory with no location anchoring

Event detail/RSVP/buy/interest screen adapted from the main app's app/events/[alias].tsx to this app's auth context field names (user.display_name) and colors; adds an in-app RsvpWebViewModal (embeds the existing public /{alias}/rsvp page) for non-ticketed events since there is no JSON RSVP API — otherwise the same hashtags/gallery/info-sections/interest UI

Foreground poll of the events directory near the saved location, diffed against a locally persisted seen-id set, surfaced as a deep-linking in-app banner + tab badge (see app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx); deliberately client-side only since no push/notification backend exists for events in the standalone app

Standalone-only: embeds the existing public /{alias}/rsvp page in a WebView (same pattern as MapPickerModal) so free RSVP happens in-app without a new backend endpoint; detects success via the redirect to /rsvp/manage/.
duplicates review screen adapted from the main app's app/contact-duplicates.tsx (nullable display_name); reached from the device-import completion alert on the contacts tab
